records.literal_gloss: And the days which we walked from Kadesh-barnea until that we passed over the wadi of Zered [were] thirty and eight year[s], until was finished all the generation, the men of the war, from [the] midst of the camp, as had sworn Yahweh to them.

en.L: And the days that we walked from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the wadi of Zered [were] thirty-eight years, until the whole generation, the men of war, had come to an end from the midst of the camp, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had sworn to them.
en.B: The time from when we left Kadesh-barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley was thirty-eight years. That was how long it took for the whole generation of fighting men to die out from the camp, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had sworn to them.
en.R: From the time we left Kadesh-barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley, thirty-eight years went by. In that time all the men who had been old enough to fight died, and none of them were left in the camp. This happened just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had sworn to them it would.

es.L: Y los días que anduvimos desde Cades-barnea hasta que cruzamos el torrente de Zered [fueron] treinta y ocho años, hasta que se acabó toda la generación, los hombres de guerra, de en medio del campamento, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había jurado.
es.B: Desde que salimos de Cades-barnea hasta que cruzamos el valle de Zered pasaron treinta y ocho años. Ese fue el tiempo que tardó en desaparecer del campamento toda la generación de los hombres aptos para la guerra, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había jurado.
es.R: Pasaron treinta y ocho años desde que salimos de Cades-barnea hasta que cruzamos el valle de Zered. En ese tiempo murieron todos los hombres que tenían edad para ir a la guerra, y no quedó ninguno de ellos en el campamento. Así sucedió, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había jurado.

fr.L: Et les jours que nous avons marché depuis Kadesh-Barnéa jusqu’à ce que nous ayons passé le torrent du Zéred [ont été] de trente-huit ans, jusqu’à ce que toute la génération, les hommes de guerre, ait disparu du milieu du camp, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le leur avait juré.
fr.B: Entre notre départ de Kadesh-Barnéa et notre passage de la vallée du Zéred, il s’est écoulé trente-huit ans. C’est le temps qu’il a fallu pour que toute la génération des combattants disparaisse du camp, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le leur avait juré.
fr.R: Trente-huit ans ont passé depuis notre départ de Kadesh-Barnéa jusqu’au moment où nous avons traversé la vallée du Zéred. Pendant ce temps, tous les hommes qui avaient été assez âgés pour combattre sont morts, et il n’en est resté aucun dans le camp. Cela s’est passé exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le leur avait juré.

sw.L: Na siku tulizotembea kutoka Kadesh-barnea hadi tulipovuka kijito cha Zeredi [zilikuwa] miaka thelathini na minane, hadi kizazi chote, watu wa vita, kilipokwisha kutoka katikati ya kambi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amewaapia.
sw.B: Tangu tulipoondoka Kadesh-barnea hadi tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi ilikuwa miaka thelathini na minane. Huo ndio muda uliohitajika ili kizazi chote cha wanaume wa vita kitoweke kambini, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amewaapia.
sw.R: Miaka thelathini na minane ilipita tangu tulipoondoka Kadesh-barnea hadi tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi. Katika muda huo wanaume wote waliokuwa na umri wa kwenda vitani walikufa, wala hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyebaki kambini. Ndivyo ilivyotokea, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amewaapia.

ko.L: 그리고 우리가 가데스바네아에서 떠나 세렛 골짜기를 건널 때까지 걸어온 날들은 삼십팔 년이었으니, 그동안 그 세대, 곧 전쟁하는 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 맹세하신 대로 진 가운데서 모두 끝났다.
ko.B: 우리가 가데스바네아를 떠나서 세렛 골짜기를 건너기까지 삼십팔 년이 걸렸다. 그동안 싸울 수 있는 남자들의 그 세대가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 맹세하신 대로 진에서 다 사라졌다.
ko.R: 우리가 가데스바네아를 떠나서 세렛 골짜기를 건너기까지 삼십팔 년이 지났습니다. 그동안 싸움에 나갈 나이가 되었던 남자들은 모두 죽었고, 진에는 그들 가운데 아무도 남지 않았습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 맹세하신 그대로 되었습니다.

decisions.choice: as the LORD had sworn to them: the oath that this generation would not enter the land
decisions.reason: When the people refused to go up from Kadesh-barnea, the LORD swore that none of that evil generation would see the good land (1:34-35; Numbers 14:21-35). These verses record that the oath was carried out.

decisions.choice: thirty-eight years: the time from Kadesh-barnea to the Zered
decisions.reason: With the journey from Egypt to Kadesh-barnea, this makes up the forty years of verse 7 and Numbers 14:33-34.

decisions.choice: the men of war: the men counted for the army
decisions.reason: These are the men twenty years old and up who were counted in the census (Numbers 1:3) and who were condemned to die in the wilderness (Numbers 14:29).

decisions.choice: all the men who had been old enough to fight
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the men of war" from Numbers 14:29, so that the reader does not take it to mean only professional soldiers.

source.text: וְגַ֤ם יַד־יְהוָה֙ הָ֣יְתָה בָּ֔ם לְהֻמָּ֖ם מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And also [the] hand of Yahweh was against them, to throw them into confusion from [the] midst of the camp, until they were finished.

en.L: And also the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was against them, to rout them from the midst of the camp, until they were finished.
en.B: Indeed, the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was against them, sweeping them out of the camp until none of them were left.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} was against them. He kept removing them from the camp until they were all gone.

es.L: Y también la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estuvo contra ellos, para desbaratarlos de en medio del campamento, hasta que se acabaron.
es.B: En efecto, la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estuvo contra ellos, barriéndolos del campamento hasta que no quedó ninguno.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo estaba contra ellos. Los fue quitando del campamento hasta que desaparecieron todos.

fr.L: Et aussi la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a été contre eux, pour les mettre en déroute du milieu du camp, jusqu’à ce qu’ils aient disparu.
fr.B: Oui, la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est abattue sur eux pour les éliminer du camp, jusqu’à ce qu’il n’en reste plus un seul.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} était contre eux. Il les a retirés du camp, l’un après l’autre, jusqu’à ce qu’ils aient tous disparu.

sw.L: Na pia mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa juu yao, kuwafadhaisha watoke katikati ya kambi, hadi walipokwisha.
sw.B: Naam, mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa dhidi yao, ukiwaondoa kambini hadi hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyebaki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mwenyewe alikuwa dhidi yao. Aliendelea kuwaondoa kambini mpaka wote wakatoweka.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손도 그들을 쳐서, 그들이 다 끝날 때까지 진 가운데서 그들을 어지럽혀 멸하셨다.
ko.B: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손이 그들을 치셔서, 그들이 하나도 남지 않을 때까지 진에서 그들을 쓸어 내셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그들을 치셨습니다. 그분께서는 그들이 모두 없어질 때까지 진에서 그들을 없애셨습니다.

decisions.choice: the hand of the LORD was against them: God's power at work in judgment
decisions.reason: The "hand" of the LORD is his power. Against someone, it brings punishment (Exodus 9:3; 1 Samuel 5:6).

decisions.choice: rout: throw into confusion and destroy
decisions.reason: The verb is used for God throwing enemy armies into panic in battle (Exodus 14:24; Joshua 10:10). Here it is turned against the rebel generation within Israel's own camp.

decisions.choice: and also: their deaths were not only the passing of time
decisions.reason: Verse 14 says the generation came to an end; this verse adds that it was God's doing, as he had sworn.

decisions.choice: The LORD himself was against them
decisions.reason: Readable puts "the hand of the LORD" in plain words.

source.text: וַיְהִ֨י כַאֲשֶׁר־תַּ֜מּוּ כָּל־אַנְשֵׁ֧י הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה לָמ֖וּת מִקֶּ֥רֶב הָעָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when had finished all [the] men of the war to die from [the] midst of the people,

en.L: And it was, when all the men of war had finished dying from the midst of the people,
en.B: When every one of the fighting men had died and was gone from among the people,
en.R: At last all those fighting men had died and were gone from among the people.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando acabaron de morir todos los hombres de guerra de en medio del pueblo,
es.B: Cuando ya habían muerto todos los hombres de guerra y no quedaba ninguno en medio del pueblo,
es.R: Por fin, todos aquellos hombres de guerra habían muerto y ya no estaban entre el pueblo.

fr.L: Et il est arrivé, quand tous les hommes de guerre ont eu fini de mourir du milieu du peuple,
fr.B: Quand le dernier des combattants est mort et a disparu du milieu du peuple,
fr.R: Enfin, tous ces combattants étaient morts et avaient disparu du milieu du peuple.

sw.L: Ikawa, watu wote wa vita walipokwisha kufa kutoka katikati ya watu,
sw.B: Wanaume wote wa vita walipokwisha kufa na kutoweka katikati ya watu,
sw.R: Mwishowe wanaume wote hao wa vita walikuwa wamekufa na kutoweka katikati ya watu.

ko.L: 그리고 전쟁하는 사람들이 모두 백성 가운데서 죽어 끝났을 때,
ko.B: 싸울 수 있는 남자들이 모두 죽어 백성 가운데서 사라졌을 때,
ko.R: 마침내 그 싸움에 나갔던 남자들이 모두 죽어 백성 가운데서 없어졌습니다.

decisions.choice: when ... had finished dying: the sentence goes on into verse 17
decisions.reason: Only once the old generation was gone did the LORD speak again about moving forward. The word "finished" repeats the end of verse 15.

decisions.choice: a sentence of its own
decisions.reason: Readable ends the sentence here and starts verse 17 with "Then".

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: that spoke Yahweh to me, saying,

en.L: that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to me, saying,
en.B: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me,
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me,

es.L: que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me habló, diciendo:
es.B: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo:
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo:

fr.L: que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a parlé, en disant :
fr.B: {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit :
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit :

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema nami, akisema,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia,
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia,

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하여 이르셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: no word for "saying"
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

source.text: אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־עָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: You [are] passing over the day [the] border of Moab, Ar.

en.L: 'You [are] crossing over today the border of Moab, Ar.
en.B: 'Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar.
en.R: 'Today you will cross Moab's border at Ar.

es.L: “Tú [estás] pasando hoy la frontera de Moab, Ar.
es.B: “Hoy vas a cruzar la frontera de Moab, a la altura de Ar.
es.R: “Hoy cruzarás la frontera de Moab por Ar.

fr.L: “Tu passes aujourd’hui la frontière de Moab, Ar.
fr.B: “Tu es sur le point de franchir aujourd’hui la frontière de Moab, à Ar.
fr.R: “Aujourd’hui, tu vas passer la frontière de Moab, à Ar.

sw.L: 'Wewe unavuka leo mpaka wa Moabu, Ari.
sw.B: 'Leo utavuka mpaka wa Moabu huko Ari.
sw.R: 'Leo utavuka mpaka wa Moabu kwenye Ari.

ko.L: '너는 오늘 모압의 경계, 곧 아르를 지나가려 한다.
ko.B: '너는 오늘 아르에서 모압의 경계를 지나가게 된다.
ko.R: '너희는 오늘 아르에서 모압의 경계를 건너게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: the border of Moab, Ar: Ar names the place where Israel passes Moab's border
alternatives: the border of Moab, that is, the territory of Ar
decisions.reason: Ar stands beside "the border of Moab" without a linking word. It probably marks the point on Moab's northern edge, by the Arnon, where Israel would pass (Numbers 21:15). It could also stand for the territory of Moab as a whole, as in verses 9 and 29.

decisions.choice: you are crossing today: about to happen now
decisions.reason: The participle describes something on the point of happening. "You" is singular, Israel as one people.

source.text: וְקָרַבְתָּ֗ מ֚וּל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן אַל־תְּצֻרֵ֖ם וְאַל־תִּתְגָּ֣ר בָּ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא־אֶ֠תֵּן מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֤וֹן לְךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י לִבְנֵי־ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥יהָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will draw near opposite [the] sons of Ammon; do not harass them and do not engage in strife with them, for not I will give of [the] land of [the] sons of Ammon to you [as] a possession, for to [the] sons of Lot I have given it [as] a possession.

en.L: And you will come near opposite the sons of Ammon. Do not harass them and do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon [as] a possession, for to the sons of Lot I have given it [as] a possession.'
en.B: When you come close to the Ammonites, do not treat them as enemies or start a fight with them, for I will not give you any of the Ammonites' land to possess. I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their own.'
en.R: You will come near the land of the Ammonites. Do not attack them or try to fight them. I will not give you any of their land, because I have given it to Lot's descendants to be their own.'

es.L: Y te acercarás frente a los hijos de Amón; no los hostigues ni los provoques, porque no te daré de la tierra de los hijos de Amón [como] posesión, porque a los hijos de Lot se la he dado [como] posesión.”
es.B: Cuando llegues cerca de los amonitas, no los trates como enemigos ni entables pelea con ellos, porque no te daré nada de la tierra de los amonitas como posesión. Se la he dado a los descendientes de Lot para que sea suya.”
es.R: Llegarás cerca de la tierra de los amonitas. No los ataques ni trates de pelear con ellos. No te daré nada de su tierra, porque se la he dado a los descendientes de Lot para que sea de ellos.”

fr.L: Et tu approcheras en face des fils d’Ammon ; ne les harcèle pas et ne les provoque pas, car je ne te donnerai rien du pays des fils d’Ammon [en] possession, car c’est aux fils de Loth que je l’ai donné [en] possession.”
fr.B: Quand tu arriveras près des Ammonites, ne les traite pas en ennemis et n’engage pas le combat avec eux, car je ne te donnerai aucune partie du pays des Ammonites en possession : je l’ai donné aux descendants de Loth pour qu’il soit à eux.”
fr.R: Tu vas arriver près du pays des Ammonites. Ne les attaque pas et n’essaie pas de te battre contre eux. Je ne te donnerai rien de leur pays, parce que je l’ai donné aux descendants de Loth pour qu’il soit à eux.”

sw.L: Nawe utakaribia mkabala na wana wa Amoni; usiwasumbue wala usiwachokoze, kwa maana sitakupa sehemu ya nchi ya wana wa Amoni [kuwa] milki, kwa sababu nimewapa wana wa Lutu [kuwa] milki.'
sw.B: Utakapowakaribia Waamoni, usiwafanye kuwa adui wala usianzishe ugomvi nao, kwa maana sitakupa sehemu yoyote ya nchi ya Waamoni iwe milki yako. Nimewapa wazao wa Lutu iwe yao.'
sw.R: Utafika karibu na nchi ya Waamoni. Usiwashambulie wala usijaribu kupigana nao. Sitakupa sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao, kwa sababu nimewapa wazao wa Lutu iwe yao.'

ko.L: 그리고 너는 암몬 자손 맞은편에 가까이 이를 것이다. 너는 그들을 괴롭히지 말고 그들과 다투지 말라. 내가 암몬 자손의 땅은 하나도 너에게 소유로 주지 않을 것이다. 내가 그것을 롯의 자손에게 소유로 주었기 때문이다.'
ko.B: 너희가 암몬 사람들 가까이에 이르게 되더라도, 그들을 원수처럼 대하지 말고 그들과 싸움을 일으키지 말라. 나는 암몬 사람들의 땅을 하나도 너희에게 소유로 주지 않을 것이다. 그 땅은 내가 롯의 자손에게 소유로 주었다.'
ko.R: 너희는 암몬 사람들의 땅 가까이에 이를 것이다. 그들을 공격하거나 그들과 싸우려고 하지 말라. 나는 그들의 땅을 하나도 너희에게 주지 않겠다. 그 땅은 내가 롯의 자손에게 주어 그들의 땅이 되게 했다.'

decisions.choice: the same command as for Edom and Moab
decisions.reason: The words repeat verses 5 and 9. Edom, Moab and Ammon, Israel's three related neighbors, are each protected by God's gift of their land.

decisions.choice: the sons of Ammon: the Ammonites, east of the upper Jabbok
decisions.reason: Ammon descended from Lot's younger son (Genesis 19:38). Their land lay on the desert side of Sihon's kingdom, around the upper Jabbok (verse 37; Numbers 21:24).

decisions.choice: the Ammonites
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 21:24: Balanced and Readable name the people; Literal keeps "the sons of Ammon".

source.text: אֶֽרֶץ־רְפָאִ֥ים תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אַף־הִ֑וא רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָהּ֙ לְפָנִ֔ים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] land of Rephaim it was regarded, also it; Rephaim dwelt in it formerly, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

en.L: (A land of Rephaim it also was counted; Rephaim formerly lived in it, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
en.B: (That land too was counted as a land of the Rephaim. The Rephaim used to live there, though the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
en.R: (This land was also thought of as a land of the Rephaim. Rephaim had lived there long ago. The Ammonites called them Zamzummim.

es.L: (Por tierra de refaítas era tenida también ella; refaítas habitaron en ella antes, y los amonitas los llaman zamzumitas,
es.B: (También esa tierra era considerada tierra de refaítas. Allí vivían antes los refaítas, aunque los amonitas los llaman zamzumitas,
es.R: (Esta tierra también se consideraba tierra de los refaítas. Hace mucho tiempo, allí habían vivido refaítas. Los amonitas los llamaban zamzumitas.

fr.L: (Pour un pays de Rephaïm il était compté, lui aussi ; des Rephaïm y habitaient autrefois, et les Ammonites les appellent Zamzoummim,
fr.B: (Ce pays aussi était considéré comme un pays de Rephaïm. Les Rephaïm y habitaient autrefois, mais les Ammonites les appellent Zamzoummim,
fr.R: (Ce pays aussi était vu comme un pays des Rephaïm. Il y a longtemps, des Rephaïm y avaient vécu. Les Ammonites les appelaient Zamzoummim.

sw.L: (Nayo ilihesabiwa kuwa nchi ya Warefai; Warefai walikaa humo zamani, na Waamoni huwaita Wazamzumi,
sw.B: (Nchi hiyo nayo ilihesabiwa kuwa nchi ya Warefai. Warefai waliishi humo zamani, ingawa Waamoni huwaita Wazamzumi,
sw.R: (Nchi hii nayo ilijulikana kuwa nchi ya Warefai. Zamani sana Warefai waliishi humo. Waamoni waliwaita Wazamzumi.

ko.L: (그곳도 르바임의 땅으로 여겨졌다. 전에는 르바임이 거기에 살았는데, 암몬 사람은 그들을 삼숨밈이라고 부른다.
ko.B: (그 땅도 르바임의 땅으로 여겨졌다. 전에는 르바임이 그곳에 살았는데, 암몬 사람들은 그들을 삼숨밈이라고 부른다.
ko.R: (이 땅도 르바임의 땅이라고 여겨졌습니다. 오래전에는 르바임이 거기에 살았습니다. 암몬 사람들은 그들을 삼숨밈이라고 불렀습니다.

decisions.choice: verses 20-23 are a second explanatory aside about earlier peoples
decisions.reason: As in verses 10-12, the LORD's words stop (at the end of verse 19) and a note explains who held Ammon's land before the Ammonites, adding the examples of Seir and of the coast near Gaza. The LORD's words take up again in verse 24. The note makes the same point as the first: God gives lands to peoples and takes them away, even from peoples as strong as the Anakim.

decisions.choice: Zamzummim: the Ammonites' name for the Rephaim of their land
decisions.reason: The name is found only here. It may be the same people as the Zuzim of Genesis 14:5, who are named beside the Rephaim and the Emim. Its meaning is not known for certain.

decisions.choice: Rephaim: as in verse 11
decisions.reason: The general name for the tall ancient peoples of the region.

decisions.choice: parentheses around verses 20-23
decisions.reason: As in verses 10-12, the parentheses mark the note set into the LORD's words.

source.text: עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְרַ֛ב וָרָ֖ם כָּעֲנָקִ֑ים וַיַּשְׁמִידֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּירָשֻׁ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: a people great and numerous and tall like the Anakim; and destroyed them Yahweh from before them, and they dispossessed them and dwelt in their place,

en.L: a people great and many and tall like the Anakim; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} destroyed them from before them, and they dispossessed them and lived in their place,
en.B: a great people, numerous and as tall as the Anakim. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} wiped them out to make way for the Ammonites, who took over their land and settled there in their place,
en.R: They were a powerful nation with many people, as tall as the Anakim. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} destroyed them as the Ammonites came in. The Ammonites forced them out and settled where they had lived.

es.L: un pueblo grande y numeroso y alto como los anaquitas; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los destruyó delante de ellos, y ellos los desposeyeron y habitaron en su lugar,
es.B: un pueblo grande, numeroso y tan alto como los anaquitas. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los exterminó para abrir paso a los amonitas, que se apoderaron de su tierra y se establecieron en su lugar,
es.R: Eran una nación poderosa, con mucha gente, y tan altos como los anaquitas. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los destruyó cuando llegaron los amonitas. Los amonitas los echaron y se quedaron a vivir donde ellos habían vivido.

fr.L: un peuple grand et nombreux et de haute taille comme les Anakim ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a détruits devant eux, et ils les ont dépossédés et ont habité à leur place,
fr.B: un peuple grand, nombreux et de haute taille comme les Anakim. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a exterminés devant les Ammonites, qui ont pris leur pays et se sont installés à leur place,
fr.R: C’était une nation puissante, avec beaucoup de gens, aussi grands que les Anakim. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a détruits quand les Ammonites sont arrivés. Les Ammonites les ont chassés et se sont installés là où ils vivaient.

sw.L: watu wakubwa na wengi na warefu kama Waanaki; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawaangamiza mbele yao, nao wakawafukuza, wakakaa mahali pao,
sw.B: taifa kubwa, lenye watu wengi na warefu kama Waanaki. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaangamiza ili kuwapisha Waamoni, ambao waliichukua nchi yao, wakakaa mahali pao,
sw.R: Walikuwa taifa lenye nguvu, lenye watu wengi, warefu kama Waanaki. Lakini Waamoni walipoingia, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaangamiza watu hao. Waamoni waliwafukuza, wakakaa mahali walipoishi.

ko.L: [그들은] 크고 수가 많으며 아낙 사람처럼 키가 큰 백성이었다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들 앞에서 그들을 멸하셨고, 그들이 그들을 쫓아내고 그들의 자리에 살았다.
ko.B: 그들은 강하고 수가 많은 백성이었으며, 아낙 사람들만큼 키가 컸다. 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 암몬 사람들 앞에서 그들을 멸하셨고, 암몬 사람들은 그들을 쫓아내고 그 자리에 자리 잡았다.
ko.R: 그들은 사람이 많은 강한 민족이었고, 아낙 사람들만큼 키가 컸습니다. 그러나 암몬 사람들이 들어오자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 멸하셨습니다. 암몬 사람들은 그들을 쫓아내고 그들이 살던 곳에 자리 잡았습니다.

decisions.choice: the LORD destroyed them: God rules the history of other nations too
decisions.reason: In verse 12 the descendants of Esau are said to destroy the Horites; here and in verse 22 the LORD is the one who did it. The movement of peoples is God's work, for nations other than Israel as well (Amos 9:7).

decisions.choice: from before them ... they dispossessed them: the Ammonites drove out the Zamzummim
decisions.reason: "Them" after "destroyed" is the Zamzummim; "before them" and "they" are the Ammonites, who then lived in their place.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the Ammonites so that the reader can tell the two peoples apart.

source.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִשְׁמִ֤יד אֶת־הַחֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽירָשֻׁם֙ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: just as he did for [the] sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them, and they dispossessed them and dwelt in their place until the day this.

en.L: just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had done for the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} destroyed the Horites from before them, and they dispossessed them and have lived in their place until this day.
en.B: just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had done for the descendants of Esau who live in Seir, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wiped out the Horites before them, so that they took over the Horites' land and live there still, to this day.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} did this for Esau's descendants in Seir too. He destroyed the Horites as Esau's descendants came in. They forced the Horites out, and they still live there today.

es.L: como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había hecho por los hijos de Esaú, que habitan en Seír, cuando destruyó a los horeos delante de ellos; y ellos los desposeyeron y han habitado en su lugar hasta este día.
es.B: así como lo había hecho por los descendientes de Esaú que viven en Seír, cuando exterminó a los horeos delante de ellos, de modo que se apoderaron de la tierra de los horeos y siguen viviendo allí hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho lo mismo por los descendientes de Esaú en Seír. Destruyó a los horeos cuando llegaron los descendientes de Esaú. Ellos echaron a los horeos, y todavía hoy viven allí.

fr.L: comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait fait pour les fils d’Ésaü, qui habitent en Séir, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit les Horiens devant eux ; et ils les ont dépossédés et ont habité à leur place jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait fait pour les descendants d’Ésaü qui habitent en Séir, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a exterminé les Horiens devant eux : ils ont pris le pays des Horiens et ils y habitent encore aujourd’hui.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait la même chose pour les descendants d’Ésaü en Séir. Il a détruit les Horiens quand les descendants d’Ésaü sont arrivés. Ceux-ci ont chassé les Horiens, et ils vivent encore là aujourd’hui.

sw.L: kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyowafanyia wana wa Esau, wakaao Seiri, alipowaangamiza Wahori mbele yao; nao wakawafukuza, wakakaa mahali pao hadi leo hii.
sw.B: kama vile alivyokuwa amewafanyia wazao wa Esau wanaoishi Seiri, alipowaangamiza Wahori mbele yao, nao wakaichukua nchi ya Wahori na wanaishi humo mpaka leo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafanyia wazao wa Esau huko Seiri vivyo hivyo. Aliwaangamiza Wahori wazao wa Esau walipoingia. Wao waliwafukuza Wahori, na mpaka leo bado wanaishi huko.

ko.L: 그분께서 세일에 사는 에서의 자손을 위하여, 그들 앞에서 호리 사람을 멸하셨을 때 하신 것과 같았으니, 그들이 그들을 쫓아내고 오늘까지 그들의 자리에 살고 있다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 세일에 사는 에서의 자손을 위해서도 그렇게 하셨다. 그들 앞에서 호리 사람들을 멸하셔서, 에서의 자손이 호리 사람들의 땅을 차지하고 오늘날까지 거기에 살고 있다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 세일에 사는 에서의 자손을 위해서도 그렇게 하셨습니다. 에서의 자손이 들어오자 그분께서 호리 사람들을 멸하셨습니다. 에서의 자손은 호리 사람들을 쫓아냈고, 오늘날까지 그곳에 살고 있습니다.

decisions.choice: the Horites: as in verse 12
decisions.reason: Verse 12 told how Esau's descendants took Seir from the Horites. Here the same event is credited to God.

decisions.choice: until this day: up to the time of the speaker
decisions.reason: The phrase looks at the situation as it still stood when these words were spoken or written: Edom still held Seir.

decisions.choice: The LORD had done
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and names the LORD, who is the subject of "he did" in the Hebrew (verse 21).

source.text: וְהָֽעַוִּ֛ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בַּחֲצֵרִ֖ים עַד־עַזָּ֑ה כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִכַּפְתּ֔וֹר הִשְׁמִידֻ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the Avvites who dwelt in villages as far as Gaza, [the] Caphtorim who came out from Caphtor destroyed them and dwelt in their place.

en.L: And the Avvites, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim who came out from Caphtor destroyed them and lived in their place.)
en.B: The Avvites, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, were wiped out by the Caphtorim, who came from Caphtor and settled where the Avvites had been.)
en.R: Also, the Avvites once lived in villages all the way to Gaza. But the Caphtorim, who came from a land called Caphtor, destroyed them and settled in their land.)

es.L: Y a los aveos, que habitaban en aldeas hasta Gaza, los Caftorim que salieron de Caftor los destruyeron y habitaron en su lugar.)
es.B: A los aveos, que vivían en aldeas hasta Gaza, los exterminaron los Caftorim, que vinieron de Caftor y se establecieron en su lugar.)
es.R: También los aveos vivían antes en aldeas hasta Gaza. Pero los Caftorim, que vinieron de una tierra llamada Caftor, los destruyeron y se quedaron con su tierra.)

fr.L: Et les Avvites, qui habitaient dans des villages jusqu’à Gaza, les Caphtorim sortis de Caphtor les ont détruits et ont habité à leur place.)
fr.B: Quant aux Avvites, qui habitaient dans des villages jusqu’à Gaza, ils ont été exterminés par les Caphtorim, venus de Caphtor, qui se sont installés à leur place.)
fr.R: De même, les Avvites vivaient autrefois dans des villages jusqu’à Gaza. Mais les Caphtorim, venus d’un pays appelé Caphtor, les ont détruits et se sont installés dans leur pays.)

sw.L: Na Waavi, waliokaa katika vijiji hadi Gaza, Wakaftori waliotoka Kaftori waliwaangamiza, wakakaa mahali pao.)
sw.B: Waavi, walioishi katika vijiji hadi Gaza, waliangamizwa na Wakaftori, waliotoka Kaftori wakakaa mahali pao.)
sw.R: Pia, zamani Waavi waliishi katika vijiji hadi Gaza. Lakini Wakaftori, waliotoka katika nchi iitwayo Kaftori, waliwaangamiza, wakakaa katika nchi yao.)

ko.L: 또 가사까지 마을들에 살던 아위 사람은, 갑돌에서 나온 갑돌 사람이 그들을 멸하고 그들의 자리에 살았다.)
ko.B: 가사에 이르기까지 여러 마을에 살던 아위 사람들은 갑돌에서 온 갑돌 사람들에게 멸망했고, 갑돌 사람들이 그 자리에 자리 잡았다.)
ko.R: 또 아위 사람들은 한때 가사에 이르기까지 여러 마을에 살았습니다. 그러나 갑돌이라는 땅에서 온 갑돌 사람들이 그들을 멸하고 그 땅에 자리 잡았습니다.)

decisions.choice: the Avvites near Gaza: an early people of the coastal plain
decisions.reason: The Avvites lived in the south-west, on the coast near Gaza. Joshua 13:3 still mentions them there.

decisions.choice: the Caphtorim from Caphtor: newcomers from across the sea, linked with the Philistines
decisions.reason: Caphtor is most likely the island of Crete. The Philistines are said to have come from Caphtor (Jeremiah 47:4; Amos 9:7), and Genesis 10:14 names the Caphtorim beside them.

decisions.choice: the last example of the aside: a people that came from far away
decisions.reason: Unlike the earlier examples, this one is not about Israel's relatives, and God is not named. It shows simply that lands change hands. After it, the LORD's words resume in verse 24.

decisions.choice: a land called Caphtor
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Caphtor is a place, without settling where it was.

source.text: ק֣וּמוּ סְּע֗וּ וְעִבְרוּ֮ אֶת־נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹן֒ רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠יָדְךָ אֶת־סִיחֹ֨ן מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן הָֽאֱמֹרִ֛י וְאֶת־אַרְצ֖וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֑שׁ וְהִתְגָּ֥ר בּ֖וֹ מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, set out, and pass over the wadi of Arnon; see, I have given into your hand Sihon, king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land; begin, take possession, and engage in strife with him [in] battle.

en.L: 'Arise, set out, and cross over the wadi of Arnon. See, I have given into your hand Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land. Begin, take possession, and provoke him to battle.
en.B: 'Get up, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. Look, I have handed Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, over to you, and his land with him. Start taking his land, and make war on him.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'Get moving now, and cross the Arnon River. Look, I have put Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon, in your power, and his land too. Start taking it over. Go to war against him.

es.L: “{{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}, {{plural_you:partan|partid}} y {{plural_you:crucen|cruzad}} el torrente de Arnón. Mira, he entregado en tu mano a Sijón, rey de Hesbón, el amorreo, y su tierra. Comienza, toma posesión, y provócalo a la guerra.
es.B: “{{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}}, {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} en marcha y {{plural_you:crucen|cruzad}} el valle del Arnón. Mira, te he entregado a Sijón el amorreo, rey de Hesbón, y también su tierra. Comienza a apoderarte de su tierra y hazle la guerra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “Ahora {{plural_you:pónganse|poneos}} en camino y {{plural_you:crucen|cruzad}} el río Arnón. Mira, he puesto en tu poder a Sijón, el rey amorreo de Hesbón, y también su tierra. Empieza a conquistarla. Ve a la guerra contra él.

fr.L: “Levez-vous, partez, et passez le torrent de l’Arnon. Vois, j’ai livré dans ta main Sihon, roi de Heshbon, l’Amoréen, et son pays. Commence, prends possession, et provoque-le au combat.
fr.B: “Levez-vous, mettez-vous en route et traversez la vallée de l’Arnon. Regarde, je t’ai livré Sihon l’Amoréen, roi de Heshbon, et son pays avec lui. Commence à prendre possession de son pays, et engage la guerre contre lui.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Allez, en route maintenant ! Traversez la rivière Arnon. Regarde, j’ai mis en ton pouvoir Sihon, le roi amoréen de Heshbon, et son pays aussi. Commence à le prendre. Fais-lui la guerre.

sw.L: 'Ondokeni, safirini, mvuke kijito cha Arnoni. Tazama, nimemtia mkononi mwako Sihoni, mfalme wa Heshboni, Mwamori, pamoja na nchi yake. Anza, uimiliki, umchokoze vitani.
sw.B: 'Ondokeni, anzeni safari, mvuke Bonde la Arnoni. Tazama, nimemtia Sihoni Mwamori, mfalme wa Heshboni, mikononi mwako, pamoja na nchi yake. Anza kuimiliki nchi yake, upigane naye vita.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, 'Ondokeni sasa, mvuke Mto Arnoni. Tazama, nimemtia Sihoni, mfalme Mwamori wa Heshboni, mkononi mwako, pamoja na nchi yake. Anza kuichukua. Pigana naye vita.

ko.L: '너희는 일어나 떠나서 아르논 골짜기를 건너라. 보아라, 내가 헤스본 왕 아모리 사람 시혼과 그의 땅을 네 손에 넘겨주었다. 시작하여 차지하고, 그와 전쟁을 벌여라.
ko.B: '일어나 떠나서 아르논 골짜기를 건너가라. 보아라, 내가 헤스본 왕 아모리 사람 시혼과 그의 땅을 너희 손에 넘겨주었다. 이제 그 땅을 차지하기 시작하고, 그와 전쟁을 벌여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨습니다. '이제 일어나 떠나서 아르논 강을 건너가거라. 보아라, 내가 헤스본 왕인 아모리 사람 시혼과 그의 땅을 너희 손에 넘겨주었다. 그 땅을 차지하기 시작하여라. 그와 전쟁을 벌여라.

decisions.choice: the LORD's words from verse 19 take up again here
decisions.reason: After the second aside (verses 20-23), the LORD goes on speaking. He now gives the order that ends the time of passing by: cross the Arnon and fight.

decisions.choice: I have given: as good as done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act, though the battle is still to come (verses 32-33). What God has decided is spoken of as already done.

decisions.choice: engage him in battle: the verb Israel was forbidden to use against Edom, Moab and Ammon
decisions.reason: "Do not provoke them" was the command for Israel's relatives (verses 5, 9, 19). With Sihon the same verb becomes a command.

decisions.choice: Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite: the ruler of the land north of the Arnon
decisions.reason: Sihon had taken this land from Moab and made Heshbon his capital (Numbers 21:26). The Arnon was Moab's northern border (Numbers 21:13).

decisions.choice: The LORD said
decisions.reason: As in verse 13: Readable names the speaker after the aside.

decisions.choice: the Arnon Valley / the Arnon River
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "wadi". Balanced calls it a valley, as with the Zered (verse 13); Readable calls it a river, as Numbers 21:13 does at that level.

decisions.choice: plural commands with the plural-you setting ("levántense", "crucen"), then "tú" ("mira", "tu mano", "comienza")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from plural commands to the people to singular "see ... your hand ... begin", Israel as one. As set for Deuteronomy at 1:8, Spanish keeps both numbers; only the plural forms take the setting.

source.text: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּךָ֙ וְיִרְאָ֣תְךָ֔ עַל־פְּנֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ שִׁמְעֲךָ֔ וְרָגְז֥וּ וְחָל֖וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: The day this I will begin to put [the] dread of you and [the] fear of you on [the] face of the peoples under all the heavens, who will hear [the] report of you and will tremble and writhe because of you.

en.L: This day I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the face of the peoples under the whole heaven, who will hear the report of you and will tremble and writhe because of you.'
en.B: Starting today I will make the peoples everywhere under heaven dread you and fear you. When they hear reports about you, they will tremble and shake with terror because of you.'
en.R: Starting today, I will make nations all over the world afraid of you. When they hear about you, they will shake and be terrified.'

es.L: Este día comenzaré a poner el pavor de ti y el temor de ti sobre la faz de los pueblos debajo de todos los cielos, que oirán tu fama y temblarán y se retorcerán [de angustia] a causa de ti.”
es.B: A partir de hoy haré que todos los pueblos bajo el cielo te tengan pavor y miedo. Cuando oigan hablar de ti, temblarán y se estremecerán de terror por causa tuya.”
es.R: Desde hoy haré que las naciones de todo el mundo te tengan miedo. Cuando oigan hablar de ti, temblarán y se llenarán de terror.”

fr.L: Ce jour-ci, je commencerai à mettre la terreur de toi et la crainte de toi sur la face des peuples sous tous les cieux, qui entendront ta renommée, et trembleront et se tordront [d’angoisse] à cause de toi.”
fr.B: Dès aujourd’hui, je vais faire que les peuples de partout sous le ciel te redoutent et te craignent. Quand ils entendront parler de toi, ils trembleront et seront saisis d’angoisse à cause de toi.”
fr.R: À partir d’aujourd’hui, je vais faire que les nations du monde entier aient peur de toi. Quand elles entendront parler de toi, elles trembleront et seront terrifiées.”

sw.L: Siku hii ya leo nitaanza kutia hofu yako na woga wako juu ya nyuso za mataifa chini ya mbingu zote, watakaosikia habari zako na kutetemeka na kugaagaa [kwa uchungu] kwa sababu yako.'
sw.B: Kuanzia leo nitayafanya mataifa yote chini ya mbingu yakuogope na kukuhofu. Yatakaposikia habari zako, yatatetemeka na kugaagaa kwa hofu kwa sababu yako.'
sw.R: Kuanzia leo nitayafanya mataifa ya dunia nzima yakuogope. Yatakaposikia habari zako, yatatetemeka na kuogopa sana.'

ko.L: 오늘부터 내가 온 하늘 아래 있는 민족들에게 너에 대한 두려움과 너에 대한 무서움을 주기 시작하겠다. 그들이 네 소문을 듣고 너 때문에 떨며 괴로워할 것이다.'
ko.B: 오늘부터 나는 온 하늘 아래 있는 모든 민족이 너희를 무서워하고 두려워하게 하겠다. 그들은 너희에 대한 소문을 듣고 너희 때문에 떨며 몸서리칠 것이다.'
ko.R: 오늘부터 나는 온 세상의 민족들이 너희를 두려워하게 하겠다. 그들은 너희에 대한 소식을 듣고 무서워서 떨 것이다.'

decisions.choice: under the whole heaven: everywhere
decisions.reason: The phrase means the peoples of the world in general. In practice it means those who hear what Israel has done, as the Song at the Sea says of Philistia, Edom, Moab and Canaan (Exodus 15:14-16; compare Joshua 2:9-11).

decisions.choice: be in anguish: writhe with fear
decisions.reason: The verb is used for writhing in pain, as a woman in labor does. Here it is the shaking of deep fear.

decisions.choice: I will begin: God starts now what Israel is to begin in verse 24
decisions.reason: "Begin" is repeated: Israel is to begin to take the land, and God begins to spread fear of Israel before it. Verse 31 uses the word again.

decisions.choice: all over the world
decisions.reason: Readable gives the plain sense of "under the whole heaven".

source.text: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת אֶל־סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I sent messengers from [the] wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon [with] words of peace, saying,

en.L: And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon [with] words of peace, saying,
en.B: Then I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with an offer of peace:
en.R: Then I sent messengers from the desert of Kedemoth to Sihon, the king of Heshbon. I offered him peace with this message:

es.L: Y envié mensajeros desde el desierto de Cedemot a Sijón, rey de Hesbón, [con] palabras de paz, diciendo:
es.B: Entonces envié mensajeros desde el desierto de Cedemot a Sijón, rey de Hesbón, con una propuesta de paz:
es.R: Después envié mensajeros desde el desierto de Cedemot a Sijón, el rey de Hesbón. Le ofrecí la paz con este mensaje:

fr.L: Et j’ai envoyé des messagers du désert de Kedémoth à Sihon, roi de Heshbon, [avec] des paroles de paix, en disant :
fr.B: Alors j’ai envoyé, depuis le désert de Kedémoth, des messagers à Sihon, roi de Heshbon, avec une offre de paix :
fr.R: Ensuite, j’ai envoyé des messagers du désert de Kedémoth à Sihon, le roi de Heshbon. Je lui ai proposé la paix avec ce message :

sw.L: Nami nikatuma wajumbe kutoka nyika ya Kedemothi kwa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni [wenye] maneno ya amani, nikisema,
sw.B: Kisha nikatuma wajumbe kutoka nyika ya Kedemothi kwa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni, wakiwa na ujumbe wa amani:
sw.R: Kisha nilituma wajumbe kutoka jangwa la Kedemothi kwa Sihoni, mfalme wa Heshboni. Nilimpa ujumbe huu wa amani:

ko.L: 그리고 나는 그데못 광야에서 헤스본 왕 시혼에게 사자들을 보내어 평화의 말로 말했다.
ko.B: 그때 나는 그데못 광야에서 헤스본 왕 시혼에게 사자들을 보내어 평화를 제안했다.
ko.R: 그때 나는 그데못 광야에서 헤스본 왕 시혼에게 사자들을 보냈습니다. 나는 그에게 이런 말을 전하여 평화를 제안했습니다.

decisions.choice: words of peace: an offer made before any fighting
decisions.reason: God had already said that Sihon was given into Israel's hand (verse 24), yet Moses first asked for peaceful passage. Later law tells Israel to offer peace to a town before attacking it (20:10). Sihon's refusal (verse 30) is what brings on the war.

decisions.choice: Kedemoth: a place on the eastern edge of Sihon's land
decisions.reason: The name means "eastern places". It later became a town of Reuben given to the Levites (Joshua 13:18; 21:37). Its exact site is not known.

decisions.choice: I sent: Moses as leader of Israel
decisions.reason: Numbers 21:21 says that Israel sent the messengers. Here Moses speaks as the one who sent them on the people's behalf.

decisions.choice: an offer of peace / offered him peace
decisions.reason: "Words of peace" are a message proposing peace; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵלֵ֑ךְ לֹ֥א אָס֖וּר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃

records.literal_gloss: Let me pass through in your land; on the road, on the road I will go; not I will turn aside [to the] right or left.

en.L: 'Let me pass through your land; on the road, on the road I will go; I will not turn aside [to the] right or [to the] left.
en.B: 'Let me pass through your land. I will keep strictly to the road and will not turn off to the right or the left.
en.R: 'Let us go through your land. We will keep to the main road and not leave it to go right or left.

es.L: “Déjame pasar por tu tierra; por el camino, por el camino iré; no me apartaré [ni a la] derecha ni [a la] izquierda.
es.B: “Déjame pasar por tu tierra. Iré estrictamente por el camino, sin desviarme ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda.
es.R: “Déjanos pasar por tu tierra. Iremos por el camino principal y no nos saldremos de él ni a la derecha ni a la izquierda.

fr.L: “Laisse-moi passer par ton pays ; par la route, par la route j’irai ; je ne m’écarterai ni à droite ni à gauche.
fr.B: “Laisse-moi traverser ton pays. Je m’en tiendrai strictement à la route, sans m’en écarter ni à droite ni à gauche.
fr.R: “Laisse-nous traverser ton pays. Nous resterons sur la grande route, sans aller ni à droite ni à gauche.

sw.L: 'Niache nipite katika nchi yako; barabarani, barabarani nitakwenda; sitageuka [kwenda] kulia wala kushoto.
sw.B: 'Niruhusu nipite katika nchi yako. Nitashika barabara tu, wala sitageuka kulia au kushoto.
sw.R: 'Turuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Tutafuata barabara kuu tu, wala hatutaiacha kwenda kulia au kushoto.

ko.L: '나로 네 땅을 지나가게 하라. 내가 길로만, 길로만 가고 오른쪽으로나 왼쪽으로 벗어나지 않겠다.
ko.B: '우리가 당신의 땅을 지나가게 해 주십시오. 우리는 큰길로만 가고, 오른쪽으로도 왼쪽으로도 벗어나지 않겠습니다.
ko.R: '우리가 당신의 땅을 지나가게 해 주십시오. 우리는 큰길로만 가겠습니다. 오른쪽으로도 왼쪽으로도 벗어나지 않겠습니다.

decisions.choice: on the road, on the road: only on the road
decisions.reason: Saying the phrase twice makes it emphatic: Israel will keep to the road and nowhere else, without straying into fields or towns.

decisions.choice: let me pass, I will go: Moses speaks for the whole people
decisions.reason: The leader speaks in the singular for Israel as one body, as Israel does in Numbers 21:22.

decisions.choice: us, we
decisions.reason: Readable uses "we", since a whole people is asking to pass. Literal and Balanced keep the singular of the message.

decisions.choice: "tu" to King Sihon ("Laisse-moi", "ton pays")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew message addresses Sihon in the singular, as Hebrew addresses everyone. French Bibles keep "tu" in such messages between rulers, which is also how the French of Genesis speaks to Pharaoh; "vous" would add a courtesy the text does not mark.

decisions.choice: Moses' message to Sihon in 합쇼체 with "당신" and "우리" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "나" and "너" in the plain style
decisions.reason: A message between leaders sent by envoys would be formally polite in Korean; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "me" and singular "you". Balanced and Readable say "우리" as Moses speaks for the people, as the meaning decision notes and the English Readable does.

source.text: אֹ֣כֶל בַּכֶּ֤סֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵ֨נִי֙ וְאָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֛יִם בַּכֶּ֥סֶף תִּתֶּן־לִ֖י וְשָׁתִ֑יתִי רַ֖ק אֶעְבְּרָ֥ה בְרַגְלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Food for silver you will sell me, and I will eat; and water for silver you will give to me, and I will drink; only let me pass through on my feet,

en.L: Food for silver you will sell me, and I will eat; and water for silver you will give me, and I will drink. Only let me pass through on my feet,
en.B: Sell me food for money so that I can eat, and give me water for money so that I can drink. Just let me pass through on foot,
en.R: Sell us food and water, and we will pay you for it. Just let us walk through your land.

es.L: Comida por plata me venderás, y comeré; y agua por plata me darás, y beberé. Solamente déjame pasar a pie,
es.B: Véndeme comida por dinero para que pueda comer, y dame agua por dinero para que pueda beber. Solo déjame pasar a pie,
es.R: Véndenos comida y agua, y te la pagaremos. Solo déjanos atravesar tu tierra a pie.

fr.L: Tu me vendras de la nourriture à prix d’argent, et je mangerai ; et tu me donneras de l’eau à prix d’argent, et je boirai. Laisse-moi seulement passer à pied,
fr.B: Vends-moi de la nourriture contre de l’argent pour que je puisse manger, et donne-moi de l’eau contre de l’argent pour que je puisse boire. Laisse-moi seulement passer à pied,
fr.R: Vends-nous de la nourriture et de l’eau, et nous te les paierons. Laisse-nous seulement traverser ton pays à pied.

sw.L: Utaniuzia chakula kwa fedha, nipate kula; na utanipa maji kwa fedha, nipate kunywa. Niache tu nipite kwa miguu yangu,
sw.B: Niuzie chakula kwa fedha ili nile, na unipe maji kwa fedha ili ninywe. Niache tu nipite kwa miguu,
sw.R: Tuuzie chakula na maji, nasi tutakulipa pesa. Turuhusu tu tupite katika nchi yako kwa miguu.

ko.L: 음식을 은을 받고 나에게 팔아 내가 먹게 하고, 물도 은을 받고 나에게 주어 내가 마시게 하라. 다만 나로 걸어서 지나가게 하라.
ko.B: 먹을 것을 돈을 받고 우리에게 팔아 주시고, 마실 물도 돈을 받고 주십시오. 우리를 걸어서 지나가게만 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 먹을 것과 마실 물을 우리에게 팔아 주십시오. 우리가 값을 치르겠습니다. 다만 우리가 당신의 땅을 걸어서 지나가게만 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: let me pass through on my feet: only walking through, taking nothing
decisions.reason: To go through "on foot" means to pass as travelers do, without stopping to take land or goods.

decisions.choice: food for silver, water for silver: the same terms as in Edom
decisions.reason: Moses offers Sihon what God told Israel to do in Edom (verse 6): to pay for everything.

decisions.choice: money / pay
decisions.reason: As in verse 6.

decisions.choice: us, we
decisions.reason: As in verse 27.

source.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽשׂוּ־לִ֜י בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וְהַמּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָ֑ר עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר־אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: just as did for me [the] sons of Esau who dwell in Seir and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, until that I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God [is] giving to us.

en.L: just as the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for me, until I cross over the Jordan into the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is giving to us.'
en.B: as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I cross the Jordan into the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is giving us.'
en.R: The descendants of Esau in Seir did this for us, and so did the Moabites in Ar. Let us go on until we cross the Jordan River into the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is giving us.'

es.L: como hicieron conmigo los hijos de Esaú, que habitan en Seír, y los moabitas, que habitan en Ar, hasta que yo cruce el Jordán a la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos da.”
es.B: como lo hicieron conmigo los descendientes de Esaú que viven en Seír y los moabitas que viven en Ar, hasta que cruce el Jordán y entre en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos da.”
es.R: Los descendientes de Esaú que viven en Seír lo hicieron por nosotros, y también los moabitas de Ar. Déjanos seguir hasta que crucemos el río Jordán y entremos en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos da.”

fr.L: comme me l’ont fait les fils d’Ésaü, qui habitent en Séir, et les Moabites, qui habitent à Ar, jusqu’à ce que je passe le Jourdain vers le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous donne.”
fr.B: comme l’ont fait pour moi les descendants d’Ésaü qui habitent en Séir et les Moabites qui habitent à Ar, jusqu’à ce que je passe le Jourdain pour entrer dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous donne.”
fr.R: Les descendants d’Ésaü qui vivent en Séir l’ont fait pour nous, et les Moabites d’Ar aussi. Laisse-nous continuer jusqu’à ce que nous traversions le Jourdain pour entrer dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous donne.”

sw.L: kama walivyonifanyia wana wa Esau, wakaao Seiri, na Wamoabu, wakaao Ari, hadi nitakapovuka Yordani kuingia katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu anatupa.'
sw.B: kama walivyonifanyia wazao wa Esau wanaoishi Seiri na Wamoabu wanaoishi Ari, mpaka nivuke Yordani niingie katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu anatupa.'
sw.R: Wazao wa Esau wanaoishi Seiri walitufanyia hivyo, na Wamoabu wa Ari pia. Turuhusu tuendelee mpaka tuvuke Mto Yordani tuingie katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu anatupa.'

ko.L: 세일에 사는 에서의 자손과 아르에 사는 모압 사람이 나에게 한 것처럼 [해 다오]. 내가 요단을 건너 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 주시는 땅으로 갈 때까지 [그렇게 하라].'
ko.B: 세일에 사는 에서의 자손과 아르에 사는 모압 사람들도 우리에게 그렇게 해 주었습니다. 우리가 요단강을 건너 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 주시는 땅으로 들어갈 때까지만 그렇게 해 주십시오.'
ko.R: 세일에 사는 에서의 자손도, 아르에 사는 모압 사람들도 우리에게 그렇게 해 주었습니다. 우리가 요단강을 건너 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 주시는 땅으로 들어갈 때까지 지나가게 해 주십시오.'

decisions.choice: as the sons of Esau and the Moabites did for me: they sold Israel food and water
decisions.reason: Numbers 20:18-21 says Edom refused Israel passage through its land, and Deuteronomy 23:5 blames Ammon and Moab for not meeting Israel with bread and water. The comparison here is narrower: as Israel went along their borders, some of their people sold it supplies (verse 6). Exactly how these accounts fit together is not stated.

decisions.choice: until I cross the Jordan: Israel's goal lies west of the river
decisions.reason: Moses tells Sihon that Israel wants only to pass through; the land God is giving is across the Jordan. Sihon's land became Israel's only after he chose to fight (verses 30-36).

decisions.choice: Let us go on
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence here and supplies "Let us go on" to carry the request of verse 28 forward.

source.text: וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֗ה סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־הִקְשָׁה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־רוּח֗וֹ וְאִמֵּץ֙ אֶת־לְבָב֔וֹ לְמַ֛עַן תִּתּ֥וֹ בְיָדְךָ֖ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But not was willing Sihon king of Heshbon to let us pass through him, for had hardened Yahweh your God his spirit and had made obstinate his heart, in order to give him into your hand, as [at] the day this.

en.L: But Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing to let us pass through his [land], for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God had hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, in order to give him into your hand, as [it is] this day.
en.B: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through his land, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God had hardened his spirit and made his heart stubborn, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could hand him over to you, as you see today.
en.R: But Sihon, the king of Heshbon, would not let us go through his land. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God had made him stubborn and unwilling to change. He did this so that you could defeat Sihon, and that is what has happened.

es.L: Pero Sijón, rey de Hesbón, no quiso dejarnos pasar por su [tierra], porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios había endurecido su espíritu y obstinado su corazón, para entregarlo en tu mano, como [sucede] hoy.
es.B: Pero Sijón, rey de Hesbón, se negó a dejarnos pasar por su tierra, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios había endurecido su espíritu y obstinado su corazón, para entregártelo, como hoy lo ves.
es.R: Pero Sijón, el rey de Hesbón, no quiso dejarnos pasar por su tierra. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo había vuelto terco y sin ganas de cambiar. Lo hizo para que tú pudieras vencer a Sijón, y eso es lo que ha pasado.

fr.L: Mais Sihon, roi de Heshbon, n’a pas voulu nous laisser passer par son [pays], car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu avait endurci son esprit et rendu son cœur obstiné, afin de le livrer dans ta main, comme [c’est le cas] aujourd’hui.
fr.B: Mais Sihon, roi de Heshbon, a refusé de nous laisser traverser son pays, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu avait endurci son esprit et rendu son cœur obstiné, afin de te le livrer, comme tu le vois aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Mais Sihon, le roi de Heshbon, n’a pas voulu nous laisser traverser son pays. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu l’avait rendu têtu et l’avait empêché de changer d’avis. Il a fait cela pour que tu puisses vaincre Sihon, et c’est bien ce qui est arrivé.

sw.L: Lakini Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni hakukubali kutuacha tupite kupitia [nchi] yake, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuwa ameifanya roho yake kuwa ngumu, na kuufanya moyo wake kuwa mkaidi, ili amtie mkononi mwako, kama [ilivyo] leo hii.
sw.B: Lakini Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni alikataa kuturuhusu tupite katika nchi yake, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuwa ameifanya roho yake kuwa ngumu na moyo wake kuwa mkaidi, ili amtie mikononi mwako, kama unavyoona leo.
sw.R: Lakini Sihoni, mfalme wa Heshboni, hakutaka kuturuhusu tupite katika nchi yake. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuwa amemfanya kuwa mkaidi asiyetaka kubadili nia. Alifanya hivyo ili wewe umshinde Sihoni, na ndivyo ilivyotokea.

ko.L: 그러나 헤스본 왕 시혼은 우리가 그 [땅을] 지나가게 하려 하지 않았다. 너의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 네 손에 넘겨주시려고, 그의 영을 완고하게 하시고 그의 마음을 강퍅하게 하셨기 때문이니, 오늘 [보는] 바와 같다.
ko.B: 그러나 헤스본 왕 시혼은 우리가 자기 땅을 지나가지 못하게 했다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 영을 완고하게 하시고 그의 마음을 고집스럽게 하셨기 때문이다. 그분께서 그를 너희 손에 넘겨주시려고 그렇게 하셨으니, 오늘 너희가 보는 그대로이다.
ko.R: 그러나 헤스본 왕 시혼은 우리가 자기 땅을 지나가지 못하게 했습니다. 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 고집스럽게 하셔서 마음을 바꾸지 않게 하셨기 때문입니다. 그분께서 그렇게 하신 것은 여러분이 시혼을 무찌르게 하시려는 것이었고, 오늘 그대로 되었습니다.

decisions.choice: the LORD had hardened his spirit: Sihon's refusal served God's purpose
decisions.reason: As with Pharaoh (Exodus 4:21; 14:4), the refusal is Sihon's own ("he was not willing"), and God makes it firm so that Sihon's land, which Israel had not asked for, comes into Israel's hands. The two verbs say the same thing twice: "made hard" and "made strong".

decisions.choice: to give him into your hand: to give you victory over him
decisions.reason: "Into the hand" means into the power of someone.

decisions.choice: as this day: as is now the case
decisions.reason: The phrase points to the present situation of Moses' hearers, who now hold Sihon's land (3:12-17).

decisions.choice: your God, your hand: Moses turns to address the people
decisions.reason: In the middle of telling what "we" did, Moses speaks directly to the people ("you", singular) about what God did for them.

decisions.choice: through his [land]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "pass through him", meaning through his territory. Literal supplies "land".

decisions.choice: made him stubborn and unwilling to change
decisions.reason: Readable puts "hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate" in plain words, keeping both halves.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֨תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־סִיחֹ֖ן וְאֶת־אַרְצ֑וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֔שׁ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־אַרְצֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me, See, I have begun to give before you Sihon and his land; begin, take possession, to possess his land.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'See, I have begun to give Sihon and his land over before you. Begin, take possession, so as to take possession of his land.'
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Look, I have begun to hand Sihon and his land over to you. Start now to take possession, so that his land will be yours.'
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Look, I have started to give you Sihon and his land. Start taking over his land now, so that it will belong to you.'

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Mira, he comenzado a entregar delante de ti a Sijón y su tierra. Comienza, toma posesión, para poseer su tierra.”
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Mira, he comenzado a entregarte a Sijón y su tierra. Empieza ya a tomar posesión, para que su tierra sea tuya.”
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Mira, ya comencé a darte a Sijón y su tierra. Empieza ahora a conquistar su tierra, para que te pertenezca.”

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Vois, j’ai commencé à livrer devant toi Sihon et son pays. Commence, prends possession, afin de posséder son pays.”
fr.B: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Regarde, j’ai commencé à te livrer Sihon et son pays. Commence dès maintenant à en prendre possession, pour que son pays soit à toi.”
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Regarde, j’ai commencé à te donner Sihon et son pays. Commence maintenant à prendre son pays, pour qu’il t’appartienne.”

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Tazama, nimeanza kumtoa Sihoni na nchi yake mbele yako. Anza, umiliki, ili uimiliki nchi yake.'
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Tazama, nimeanza kumtia Sihoni na nchi yake mikononi mwako. Anza sasa kuimiliki, ili nchi yake iwe yako.'
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Tazama, nimeanza kukupa Sihoni na nchi yake. Anza sasa kuichukua nchi yake, ili iwe mali yako.'

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. '보아라, 내가 시혼과 그의 땅을 네 앞에 넘겨주기 시작했다. 너는 그의 땅을 차지하기 위하여 차지하기 시작하여라.'
ko.B: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨다. '보아라, 내가 시혼과 그의 땅을 너에게 넘겨주기 시작했다. 이제 너도 차지하기 시작하여 그의 땅을 네 것으로 삼아라.'
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '보아라, 내가 시혼과 그의 땅을 너에게 주기 시작했다. 이제 그의 땅을 차지하기 시작하여라. 그 땅이 너의 것이 될 것이다.'

decisions.choice: I have begun ... begin: God's beginning and Israel's
decisions.reason: The word "begin" from verses 24-25 comes back. God has begun to give, and Israel is to begin to take.

decisions.choice: take possession, so as to possess: an emphatic repetition
decisions.reason: The verb and its noun form are put side by side to stress the point: the land is to become Israel's possession.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵא֩ סִיחֹ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכָל־עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָֽהְצָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came out Sihon to meet us, he and all his people, for the battle, to Jahaz.

en.L: And Sihon came out to meet us, he and all his people, for battle, at Jahaz.
en.B: Sihon came out with his whole army to fight us at Jahaz.
en.R: Then Sihon and his whole army came out to fight us at Jahaz.

es.L: Y salió Sijón a nuestro encuentro, él y todo su pueblo, para la batalla, en Jahaz.
es.B: Sijón salió con todo su ejército para combatir contra nosotros en Jahaz.
es.R: Entonces Sijón y todo su ejército salieron a pelear contra nosotros en Jahaz.

fr.L: Et Sihon est sorti à notre rencontre, lui et tout son peuple, pour le combat, à Jahats.
fr.B: Sihon est sorti avec toute son armée pour nous livrer bataille à Jahats.
fr.R: Alors Sihon et toute son armée sont sortis pour nous combattre à Jahats.

sw.L: Ndipo Sihoni akatoka kukutana nasi, yeye na watu wake wote, kwa vita, huko Yahasi.
sw.B: Sihoni akatoka pamoja na jeshi lake lote ili kupigana nasi huko Yahasi.
sw.R: Kisha Sihoni na jeshi lake lote walitoka kupigana nasi huko Yahasi.

ko.L: 그리고 시혼이 우리를 맞아, 그와 그의 모든 백성이 싸우러 야하스로 나왔다.
ko.B: 시혼은 온 군대를 이끌고 야하스로 나와 우리와 맞서 싸웠다.
ko.R: 그러자 시혼과 그의 온 군대가 야하스로 나와 우리와 싸웠습니다.

decisions.choice: his people: his fighting men
decisions.reason: In a battle report, "all his people" means the men he could bring to war (Numbers 21:23).

decisions.choice: Jahaz: a town north of the Arnon
decisions.reason: Jahaz lay in the land Sihon ruled, on the edge of the wilderness (Numbers 21:23). Its exact site is not known.

decisions.choice: army
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "army" for "his people" in this battle setting.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֛הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַנַּ֥ךְ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־עַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave him Yahweh our God before us, and we struck him and his sons and all his people.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God gave him over before us, and we struck him and his sons and all his people.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God handed him over to us, and we defeated him, his sons and all his army.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God let us defeat him. We defeated Sihon, his sons, and his whole army.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios lo entregó delante de nosotros, y lo herimos a él y a sus hijos y a todo su pueblo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos lo entregó, y lo derrotamos a él, a sus hijos y a todo su ejército.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos dio la victoria sobre él. Derrotamos a Sijón, a sus hijos y a todo su ejército.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu l’a livré devant nous, et nous l’avons frappé, lui et ses fils et tout son peuple.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous l’a livré, et nous l’avons battu, lui, ses fils et toute son armée.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous a donné la victoire sur lui. Nous avons vaincu Sihon, ses fils et toute son armée.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu akamtoa mbele yetu, nasi tukampiga yeye na wanawe na watu wake wote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu akamtia mikononi mwetu, nasi tukamshinda yeye, wanawe na jeshi lake lote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alituwezesha kumshinda. Tulimshinda Sihoni, wanawe na jeshi lake lote.

ko.L: 그리고 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 우리 앞에 넘겨주셨으니, 우리는 그와 그의 아들들과 그의 모든 백성을 쳤다.
ko.B: 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 우리에게 넘겨주셨다. 우리는 그와 그의 아들들과 그의 온 군대를 쳐부수었다.
ko.R: 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리가 그를 이기게 해 주셨습니다. 우리는 시혼과 그의 아들들과 그의 온 군대를 무찔렀습니다.

decisions.choice: his sons: the reading tradition of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text can be read "his son", one son. The traditional reading that the scribes marked in the margin is "his sons", and the text here follows that. Either way, Sihon's heirs fell with him.

decisions.choice: struck: defeated in battle
decisions.reason: The verb means to strike or hit. In war it means to defeat, often with great loss of life.

decisions.choice: the LORD our God gave him over before us: the victory is God's
decisions.reason: Moses says first that God gave Sihon over, and only then that Israel struck him, as God had promised in verses 24 and 31.

decisions.choice: army
decisions.reason: As in verse 32.

source.text: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־כָּל־עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַֽנַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת־כָּל־עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּ֑ף לֹ֥א הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ שָׂרִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And we captured all his cities at the time that, and we devoted to destruction every city of men, and the women and the little ones; not we left a survivor.

en.L: And we captured all his cities at that time, and we devoted to destruction every city of men, and the women and the little ones; we did not leave a survivor.
en.B: At that time we captured all his towns and devoted every one of them to destruction, with their men, women and children. We did not leave a single survivor.
en.R: At that time we captured all of Sihon's towns. We destroyed every town completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: the men, the women, and the children. No one was left alive.

es.L: Y tomamos todas sus ciudades en aquel tiempo, y consagramos a la destrucción toda ciudad de hombres, y las mujeres y los niños; no dejamos sobreviviente.
es.B: En aquel tiempo tomamos todas sus ciudades y las consagramos todas a la destrucción, con sus hombres, mujeres y niños. No dejamos ni un solo sobreviviente.
es.R: En aquel tiempo conquistamos todas las ciudades de Sijón. Destruimos por completo cada ciudad, como algo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: a los hombres, a las mujeres y a los niños. No quedó nadie con vida.

fr.L: Et nous avons pris toutes ses villes en ce temps-là, et nous avons voué à la destruction toute ville d’hommes, et les femmes et les petits enfants ; nous n’avons pas laissé de survivant.
fr.B: À ce moment-là, nous avons pris toutes ses villes et nous les avons toutes vouées à la destruction, avec leurs hommes, leurs femmes et leurs enfants. Nous n’avons laissé aucun survivant.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, nous avons pris toutes les villes de Sihon. Nous avons détruit complètement chaque ville, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : les hommes, les femmes et les enfants. Personne n’est resté en vie.

sw.L: Nasi tukaitwaa miji yake yote wakati huo, tukaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi kila mji wa wanaume, na wanawake na watoto wadogo; hatukumwacha aliyenusurika.
sw.B: Wakati huo tuliiteka miji yake yote, tukaiweka yote wakfu kwa maangamizi, pamoja na wanaume, wanawake na watoto wake. Hatukumwacha hata mtu mmoja hai.
sw.R: Wakati huo tuliiteka miji yote ya Sihoni. Tuliuangamiza kabisa kila mji, kama kitu kilichotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: wanaume, wanawake na watoto. Hakuna aliyebaki hai.

ko.L: 그리고 그때에 우리는 그의 모든 성읍을 점령하고, 모든 성읍의 남자들과 여자들과 어린것들을 진멸했다. 우리는 살아남은 자를 하나도 남기지 않았다.
ko.B: 그때에 우리는 그의 모든 성읍을 점령하고, 성읍마다 남자와 여자와 아이들까지 모두 진멸했다. 살아남은 사람을 하나도 남기지 않았다.
ko.R: 그때에 우리는 시혼의 성읍을 모두 점령했습니다. 그리고 성읍마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바쳐 완전히 멸했습니다. 남자와 여자와 아이들까지 그렇게 했습니다. 아무도 살아남지 못했습니다.

decisions.choice: devoted to destruction: the towns and their people were given over to God
decisions.reason: The verb is the one for a "devoted thing" in Leviticus 27:28-29: something given up to the LORD for good. In war it means that a town and its people are destroyed and not kept for anyone's gain (Numbers 21:2-3; Deuteronomy 7:2; 20:16-18). Verse 35 shows that here the livestock and goods were kept.

decisions.choice: every city of men: every town with its men
decisions.reason: The word means men, adult males. With "the women and the little ones" it covers the whole population of each town.

decisions.choice: the little ones: children
decisions.reason: The word is used for children too young to fend for themselves, and sometimes for a family's dependents in general.

decisions.choice: destroyed ... completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 21:2: Readable gives the sense of the term in plain words; Literal and Balanced keep "devote to destruction".

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 21:2: "cities" in Literal; "towns" in Balanced and Readable, since these were small walled places.

decisions.choice: "vouer à la destruction"
decisions.reason: "Vouer à l'interdit" is the traditional French term, but readers outside the Bible tradition do not know it; "vouer à la destruction" keeps the idea of giving over ("vouer") and says what it meant, as the English "devote to destruction" does. As in Exodus 22:19.

decisions.choice: "kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi"
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 22:19: "wakfu" keeps the sense that the town is given over to God, and "maangamizi" says what that meant; Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "진멸하다" (Literal, Balanced) and "{Y}께 바쳐 완전히 멸하다" (Readable) for devoting to destruction
decisions.reason: As the Korean Joshua renders the same verb; Readable spells out that the towns were given over to God, as the English Readable does and the meaning decision explains.

source.text: רַ֥ק הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה בָּזַ֣זְנוּ לָ֑נוּ וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכָֽדְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Only the livestock we plundered for ourselves, and [the] spoil of the cities which we had captured.

en.L: Only the livestock we took as plunder for ourselves, and the spoil of the cities that we had captured.
en.B: We took only the livestock as plunder for ourselves, along with the spoil from the towns we had captured.
en.R: We kept only the animals and the other valuable things we took from the towns.

es.L: Solamente el ganado tomamos como botín para nosotros, y el despojo de las ciudades que habíamos tomado.
es.B: Solo nos quedamos con el ganado como botín, junto con el despojo de las ciudades que habíamos conquistado.
es.R: Solo nos quedamos con los animales y con las demás cosas de valor que tomamos de las ciudades.

fr.L: Seulement le bétail, nous l’avons pillé pour nous, ainsi que le butin des villes que nous avions prises.
fr.B: Nous n’avons pris pour nous que le bétail, avec le butin des villes que nous avions conquises.
fr.R: Nous avons gardé seulement les animaux et les autres objets de valeur que nous avons pris dans les villes.

sw.L: Ila mifugo tuliiteka nyara kwa ajili yetu, na mateka ya miji tuliyokuwa tumeitwaa.
sw.B: Tulichukua tu mifugo kuwa nyara zetu, pamoja na mateka kutoka katika miji tuliyokuwa tumeiteka.
sw.R: Tulibaki na wanyama tu na vitu vingine vya thamani tulivyochukua kutoka mijini.

ko.L: 다만 가축과 우리가 점령한 성읍들의 전리품은 우리가 우리 것으로 빼앗았다.
ko.B: 다만 가축과 우리가 점령한 성읍들에서 거둔 전리품은 우리가 가졌다.
ko.R: 우리는 가축과, 성읍들에서 가져온 값진 물건들만 우리 것으로 삼았습니다.

decisions.choice: only the livestock we took: the ban covered the people, not the animals and goods
decisions.reason: In the war with Sihon, and with Og after him (3:6-7), the people of the towns were destroyed, but Israel kept the animals and plunder. At Jericho, by contrast, everything was devoted to the LORD (Joshua 6:17-19); at Ai the livestock and plunder were again allowed (Joshua 8:2, 27).

decisions.choice: spoil: goods taken from a defeated enemy
decisions.reason: The word covers whatever was carried off after a victory: tools, clothing, metal and other valuables.

decisions.choice: the other valuable things
decisions.reason: Readable explains "spoil" in common words.

source.text: מֵֽעֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנֹ֜ן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּנַּ֨חַל֙ וְעַד־הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־הַכֹּ֕ל נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְפָנֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: From Aroer which [is] on [the] edge of [the] wadi of Arnon, and the city which [is] in the wadi, and as far as Gilead, not was there a town that was [too] high for us; the all gave Yahweh our God before us.

en.L: From Aroer, which [is] on the edge of the wadi of Arnon, and the city that [is] in the wadi, as far as Gilead, there was not a town that was too high for us; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God gave [them] all over before us.
en.B: From Aroer, which stands at the edge of the Arnon Valley, and the town that lies in the valley, as far as Gilead, not a single town stood too high for us to take. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God gave every one of them over to us.
en.R: We took every town from Aroer, on the edge of the Arnon River valley, and the town down in the valley, all the way to Gilead. None of them was too strong for us. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God gave them all to us.

es.L: Desde Aroer, que [está] a la orilla del torrente de Arnón, y la ciudad que [está] en el torrente, hasta Galaad, no hubo ciudad que fuera demasiado alta para nosotros; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios [las] entregó todas delante de nosotros.
es.B: Desde Aroer, que está al borde del valle del Arnón, y la ciudad que está en el valle, hasta Galaad, ninguna ciudad fue demasiado alta para que la tomáramos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos las entregó todas.
es.R: Tomamos todas las ciudades, desde Aroer, al borde del valle del río Arnón, y la ciudad que está abajo en el valle, hasta Galaad. Ninguna fue demasiado fuerte para nosotros. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos las dio todas.

fr.L: Depuis Aroër, qui [est] au bord du torrent de l’Arnon, et la ville qui [est] dans le torrent, jusqu’à Galaad, il n’y a pas eu de ville trop haute pour nous ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu [les] a toutes livrées devant nous.
fr.B: Depuis Aroër, au bord de la vallée de l’Arnon, et la ville qui est dans la vallée, jusqu’à Galaad, pas une seule ville n’a été trop haute pour que nous la prenions. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous les a toutes livrées.
fr.R: Nous avons pris toutes les villes, depuis Aroër, au bord de la vallée de la rivière Arnon, et la ville en bas dans la vallée, jusqu’à Galaad. Aucune n’était trop forte pour nous. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous les a toutes données.

sw.L: Kutoka Aroeri, ulio ukingoni mwa kijito cha Arnoni, na mji ulio katika kijito, hadi Gileadi, hapakuwa na mji uliokuwa juu mno kwetu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu aliitoa yote mbele yetu.
sw.B: Kutoka Aroeri, ulio ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni, na mji ulio bondeni, hadi Gileadi, hakuna mji uliokuwa juu mno tusiweze kuuteka. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alitupa yote.
sw.R: Tuliiteka miji yote, kutoka Aroeri, ulio ukingoni mwa bonde la Mto Arnoni, na mji ulio chini bondeni, hadi Gileadi. Hakuna mji uliotushinda nguvu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alitupa yote.

ko.L: 아르논 골짜기 가장자리에 있는 아로엘과 그 골짜기 안에 있는 성읍에서부터 길르앗까지, 우리에게 너무 높은 성읍이 하나도 없었다. 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 [그] 모두를 우리 앞에 넘겨주셨다.
ko.B: 아르논 골짜기 가장자리에 있는 아로엘과 그 골짜기 안에 있는 성읍에서부터 길르앗에 이르기까지, 우리가 점령하지 못할 만큼 높은 성읍은 하나도 없었다. 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 모든 성읍을 우리에게 넘겨주셨다.
ko.R: 우리는 아르논 강 골짜기 가장자리에 있는 아로엘과 그 골짜기 안에 있는 성읍에서부터 길르앗까지 모든 성읍을 차지했습니다. 우리가 이기지 못할 만큼 강한 성읍은 하나도 없었습니다. 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 성읍들을 모두 우리에게 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: too high: too strong, out of reach
decisions.reason: A town "too high" is one whose walls and position make it impossible to take. The words answer the fear of 1:28, where the spies reported towns "great and fortified up to heaven".

decisions.choice: from Aroer to Gilead: Sihon's kingdom from south to north
decisions.reason: Aroer stood on the northern rim of the Arnon gorge, Moab's border (Joshua 12:2). Gilead is the hill country to the north, toward the Jabbok.

decisions.choice: the city that is in the wadi: a town in the Arnon valley, not named
decisions.reason: The town is not named here or in Joshua 13:9, 16, which repeats the phrase. It may be Ar or another town down in the valley.

decisions.choice: too high for us to take / too strong for us
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of height and adds "to take" to show what it means; Readable says "too strong"; Literal keeps "too high".

source.text: רַ֛ק אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֖וֹן לֹ֣א קָרָ֑בְתָּ כָּל־יַ֞ד נַ֤חַל יַבֹּק֙ וְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Only to [the] land of [the] sons of Ammon not you drew near, all [the] side of [the] wadi of Jabbok and [the] cities of the hill country, and all that commanded Yahweh our God.

en.L: Only to the land of the sons of Ammon you did not come near, all the side of the wadi of Jabbok and the cities of the hill country, and all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God had commanded.
en.B: But you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, the whole region along the Jabbok River and the towns in the hill country, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God had commanded.
en.R: But you stayed away from the land of the Ammonites. You did not go near the land along the Jabbok River or the towns in the hills. You did just what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God had commanded.

es.L: Solamente a la tierra de los hijos de Amón no te acercaste, a toda la ribera del torrente de Jaboc y a las ciudades de la región montañosa, y a todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios había mandado.
es.B: Pero no te acercaste a la tierra de los amonitas, ni a toda la región a lo largo del río Jaboc ni a las ciudades de la región montañosa, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios lo había mandado.
es.R: Pero te mantuviste lejos de la tierra de los amonitas. No te acercaste a la tierra junto al río Jaboc ni a las ciudades de las colinas. Hiciste exactamente lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios había mandado.

fr.L: Seulement, du pays des fils d’Ammon tu ne t’es pas approché, de tout le bord du torrent du Jabbok et des villes de la montagne, et de tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu avait ordonné.
fr.B: Mais tu ne t’es pas approché du pays des Ammonites, de toute la région qui longe la rivière Jabbok et des villes de la montagne, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu l’avait ordonné.
fr.R: Mais tu es resté loin du pays des Ammonites. Tu ne t’es pas approché de la région le long de la rivière Jabbok, ni des villes dans les collines. Tu as fait exactement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu avait ordonné.

sw.L: Ila nchi ya wana wa Amoni hukuikaribia, ukingo wote wa kijito cha Yaboki na miji ya nchi ya milima, na yote aliyokuwa ameamuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Lakini hukuikaribia nchi ya Waamoni, eneo lote kando ya Mto Yaboki na miji iliyo katika nchi ya milima, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alivyokuwa ameamuru.
sw.R: Lakini ulikaa mbali na nchi ya Waamoni. Hukukaribia nchi iliyo kando ya Mto Yaboki wala miji iliyo vilimani. Ulifanya sawasawa na alivyokuwa ameamuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu.

ko.L: 다만 암몬 자손의 땅, 곧 얍복 골짜기 모든 연안과 산지의 성읍들과 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 모든 [곳에는] 네가 가까이 가지 않았다.
ko.B: 그러나 너희는 암몬 사람들의 땅, 곧 얍복강 가의 온 지역과 산지의 성읍들에는 가까이 가지 않았다. 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 그대로였다.
ko.R: 그러나 여러분은 암몬 사람들의 땅에는 가까이 가지 않았습니다. 얍복강을 따라 있는 땅에도, 산지에 있는 성읍들에도 가지 않았습니다. 여러분은 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 그대로 했습니다.

decisions.choice: and all that the LORD our God had commanded: Israel kept to the limits God set
alternatives: and every place that the LORD our God had forbidden
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief: "and all that the LORD our God commanded". It most likely means that Israel stayed away from every place the LORD had told it not to go near (verse 19), so that Israel acted as he had commanded. It could also continue the list, "and all the places the LORD had forbidden". Either way, Israel obeyed.

decisions.choice: all the side of the wadi of Jabbok: the land along the upper Jabbok, Ammon's territory
decisions.reason: The upper course of the Jabbok bends round through the land of the Ammonites, whose border Israel did not cross (Numbers 21:24).

decisions.choice: you did not come near: Moses turns to address the people
decisions.reason: As in verse 30, Moses moves from "we" to "you" (singular), the people as one.

decisions.choice: the Jabbok River
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 21:24 at Readable; Literal keeps "wadi".
